experiments.scope: Matched-scale grouped birthday: 32 groups x 32 m15 (N_t=2^10) on exact 2-round root compression via m15 partial evaluation. 20-bit digest-xor-mask on o0/o1/o2 low bits with N_t^2/2^w=1, matching full-scale N^2/2^256=1. Digests only from partial evaluator; organizer re-verifies. Parameters fixed before production runs.
experiments.hypothesis: Under H1-grouped-digests, masked collision detection frequency is near the random-model coverage 1-exp(-1/2)≈0.393 at this matched scale, supporting that multi-group structured prefixes do not grossly suppress masked collisions for the truncated 2-round map.

experiments.scope: Structured stress: one group, m15=0..1023 (N_t=2^10), 20-bit mask on o3/o4/o5. Same partial evaluator. Within-group pairs only — the most dependent layout. N_t^2/2^w=1 matched scaling still holds formally for the mask event.
experiments.hypothesis: Even the single-group layout yields masked-collision detections; any material depression relative to 0.393 is disclosed as a limitation of H1 for highly structured sets (within-group pairs are a 2^-96 fraction of full-scale pairs).

experiments.scope: Smaller matched scale: 16 groups x 16 m15 (N_t=2^8), 16-bit mask, N_t^2/2^w=1. Same algorithm/evaluator. Cross-scale consistency check for EXP-EXT.
experiments.hypothesis: Masked coverage frequency remains near 1-exp(-1/2) at this smaller matched scale under H1.

experiments.scope: Larger matched scale: 64 groups x 64 m15 (N_t=2^12), 24-bit mask, N_t^2/2^w=1. Same algorithm/evaluator. Cross-scale consistency check for EXP-EXT.
experiments.hypothesis: Masked coverage frequency remains near 1-exp(-1/2) at this larger matched scale under H1.
